findings.message: This value is written between the single quotes of a SQL string, so a quote in it ends the string early: the query breaks on ordinary input like `O'Brien`, and a crafted value runs as SQL. Pass it as a bound parameter (`WHERE name LIKE ?` with the value beside the query). Where the query language has no parameters, give the value a type that cannot hold a quote (a number, a union of literals, a template literal type such as `${number}-${number}-${number}`), or escape it in place with `.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/'/g, "''")`, which doubles backslashes as well as quotes.
